summary: Enterprise customer requests shadow evaluation metrics during upcoming model upgrade rollout (quality gates + dashboard/API)
body:
Issue summary
Northstar Customer Support AI (enterprise, Dedicated) is planning a production model upgrade within ~2 weeks and is requesting the ability to run shadow evaluations during rollout (mirror a sampled subset of production traffic to a candidate variant) and view quality deltas alongside latency/cost. They are asking for (a) a minimum set of quality metrics, (b) the ability to slice by route and workload segment, and (c) a "go/no-go" signal they can use as a rollout gate.

Customer context / timeline pressure
- Northstar has an internal change review on 2026-02-06 and wants evidence that the candidate model does not regress on: refusal/safety behavior, instruction-following, and output format compliance.
- They have had previous incidents during upgrades where average latency improved but answer quality degraded in subtle ways, which they did not catch until user tickets.
- They do not want any user-visible impact while collecting quality data.

Customer request (requirements)
1) Shadow traffic / mirroring
- Mirror 1–5% of production requests from Route: /v1/chat/completions (primary) to one or more candidate variants.
- Deterministic bucketing so repeated conversations are consistently assigned (so comparisons are meaningful over time).
- Fail-open guarantee: if shadow path errors, control response must still succeed and user latency must not change.

2) Quality metrics (minimum viable)
- Format adherence (JSON schema / tool-calling shape compliance) with a breakdown of failure reasons.
- Refusal rate / safety behavior: detect unexpected refusals and unexpected non-refusals for known sensitive intents.
- Instruction following (rubric score) and a "verbosity" / length drift indicator.
- Ability to export a small sample set of paired examples (control vs shadow output) for human review.

3) Visibility & gating
- Dashboard view with confidence intervals and time windows (1h/6h/24h).
- Alerting or at least a recommended threshold for "regression" (advisory is acceptable for first rollout).
- Attach results to a rollout / canary timeline so reviewers can see exactly what configuration/model was tested.

4) Data handling constraints
- Dedicated tenant with strict retention: prompts/responses retained for <= 7 days; prefer redaction and hashed identifiers.
- Ability to disable capture of raw prompts and store only scoring artifacts if needed.

Current limitations / notes
- The full "Shadow Experiments" feature is in progress. We may be able to enable a limited beta path for this tenant with guarded defaults (sampling cap, dimension cap) and provide a temporary dashboard + export.
- Need to confirm which scoring templates are production-ready for their workload and whether they require structured output evaluation.

Impact
- Customer states this is a blocker for approving the upgrade. Without a shadow quality signal, they will delay rollout or require a time-consuming manual offline evaluation.

Requested next steps
- Redwood to confirm feasibility and timeline for (1) shadow routing enablement on their tenant, (2) default metric bundle v1, and (3) dashboard access / export.
- If not feasible by 2026-02-06, provide an alternative: prompt-set eval-harness approach + guidance on sampling/power, plus a plan to run shadowing immediately after approval.

Owner notes (Support)
- This is aligned with the Shadow Traffic tool project scope. Need coordinated response across Rollouts (Paula), Evals (Jonas/Karthik), Telemetry (Logan/Nadia), and SRE (Sean/Allison) for guardrails + retention.

Attachments/refs
- HubSpot: sources/hubspot/company-northstar-customer-support-ai.json
- (Customer call notes) Fireflies: 2026-01-22 technical deep dive on shadow evals + rollouts
- Internal runbook draft: Shadow traffic rollout/rollback runbook (Confluence)

Open questions to resolve with customer
- Exact definition of "format adherence": strict JSON schema vs tool-call envelope compliance vs both.
- Whether they need per-intent segmentation (could increase cardinality risk).
- Whether shadowing should include streaming responses; if yes, what partial capture is acceptable.
- Which routes are in-scope for the first rollout (chat only vs embeddings/rerank).
comments:
2026-01-29 10:14 PT — Monica Patel (Support/Platform Enablement)
Acknowledged request from Northstar. Confirmed we can discuss limited beta access for shadow traffic + quality deltas. Asked for:
- target rollout date
- routes to include
- required metrics (must-have vs nice-to-have)
- data retention constraints (raw prompts allowed?)

Set expectation: likely advisory quality signals at launch; automatic rollback based on quality is not available yet.

Next: loop in Paula Mendes (Rollouts) + Jonas Weber (Evals) + Logan Wright (Telemetry) for feasibility and a proposed plan by EOW.

2026-01-30 09:02 PT — Customer (Northstar, Platform Eng lead)
Timeline: change review on 2026-02-06, rollout starts 2026-02-10 if approved.
Must-haves:
- shadow 2% production traffic
- format adherence + refusal drift + instruction-following rubric score
- dashboard with confidence bands (or at minimum: a daily summary with statistical significance)
- export 100–200 paired examples for audit
Constraints:
- retain prompts <= 7 days
- prefer hashed user identifiers; avoid storing full conversation histories if possible

They are OK with advisory gates but need a "recommended action" summary for reviewers (e.g., green/yellow/red).

2026-01-30 11:41 PT — Paula Mendes (Rollout policies)
We can support shadow sampling at the route level with deterministic bucketing (consistent hashing) and strict fail-open. For beta enablement we should:
- cap sampling at 2% (customer request fits)
- cap targets to 1–2 shadow variants
- ensure shadow request timeouts are < 150ms budget for routing path (async send)

Need SRE sign-off on guardrails and a kill switch plan. Also need to confirm that the Console view for quality deltas is available behind the feature flag for this tenant.

2026-01-31 14:10 PT — Jonas Weber (Evals/Scoring)
Metric feasibility:
- Format adherence: we can score tool-call envelope compliance + JSON parse success; strict schema validation requires customer-provided schema (not in v1). Proposed: v1 includes JSON parseable + required key presence.
- Refusal rate: can score via rubric template on shadow outputs; need to calibrate on their domain prompts (risk of false positives).
- Instruction-following: available as model-graded rubric; will pin rubric version for comparability.

Caveat: model-graded scoring adds compute cost; for 2% sampling we should be OK if we constrain max tokens captured/scored and use async queue with backpressure.

2026-02-01 10:55 PT — Allison Grant (Observability/Alerting)
Reminder on cardinality: no per-user or per-conversation IDs as metric labels. We can store hashed IDs in event payload for sampled examples only (separate store), but dashboards must aggregate by:
- tenant
- route
- model/control vs shadow
- region
- rubric_version

Proposed dashboards: quality delta overview (24h + rolling 6h) + scoring lag. Alerts: scoring lag and missing-data should page only if it impacts multiple tenants; for single tenant create ticket notifications.

2026-02-01 16:22 PT — Sean Gallagher (SRE)
Guardrails required before enabling on an enterprise tenant:
- circuit breaker if shadow target error rate > 10% for 5 min OR scoring queue lag > 30 min
- hard budget: user-path p99 latency delta <= 1% (shadowing must be strictly async/non-blocking)
- kill switch in control plane and documented rollback steps

If these are met, SRE OK with limited beta enablement for Northstar. Please ensure audit log entries are enabled for experiment creation/edits.

2026-02-02 09:18 PT — Monica Patel
Sent proposed plan to customer:
Option A (recommended): Enable limited beta shadow experiment for chat route at 2% sampling, 1 candidate variant, 7-day retention, redaction on by default. Provide Console dashboard access for quality deltas + export of paired examples.
Option B (fallback): If feature flag approval slips, run eval-harness prompt-set scoring using their provided prompt set and compare against candidate model offline; use this as change-review evidence.

Asked customer to confirm:
- whether streaming is enabled on their chat route (affects partial capture)
- whether they can provide a representative prompt set for calibration (for refusal/instruction-following rubrics).

2026-02-02 13:47 PT — Customer (Northstar)
Confirmed:
- Chat route is streaming-enabled for ~60% of traffic.
- They can provide a 300–500 prompt set for calibration by 2026-02-03.
- They want shadowing to cover streaming requests, but are OK if we only capture the final assembled output (not token-by-token).

They asked for written confirmation that user-path latency will not be impacted and that they can disable the experiment immediately if they see issues.
next_steps:
1) Paula Mendes to coordinate beta enablement + shadow policy config for Northstar tenant (target: 2026-02-03).
2) Jonas Weber to confirm rubric bundle v1 (format adherence JSON-parse + key checks, refusal drift rubric, instruction-following rubric) and provide rubric_version to pin.
3) Allison Grant to ensure dashboard access is enabled for tenant and dimensions are cardinality-safe.
4) Monica Patel to send customer a short enablement note including: fail-open behavior, retention defaults, and how to disable (kill switch) + expected time-to-see-metrics.
5) If any blockers by 2026-02-04: execute fallback Option B (eval-harness prompt set) for change review.
support_risk: High: enterprise change review deadline (2026-02-06). If we miss, rollout may delay and trust risk increases.
internal_notes: Coordinate with INT-912 for feature flag enablement workflow if needed. Ensure any prompt/response storage honors 7-day retention and redaction defaults. For streaming capture, align with current behavior: store final output only, mark partial=true when incomplete due to timeout.
